name: Mikoto Muller
source:
Occupation: Sorceress
Likes: Armor in general, baking
Dislikes: People who are wishy-washy, hot things/places
Character Design - Amakusa Tobari (天草帳)

[url=/c16748]Leo[/url]'s childhood friend. She's a very strong and lively poster girl for a bakery. Because she is a sorceress and a major weapon geek, she can combine the two for attacks of many different attributes. She is good at making bread but absolutely cannot handle heat.

[Taken from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Valkyrie_Complex]Wikipedia[/url].]
